risks.title: Dependence on High Leverage
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, with a significant increase in interest expenses (+24% YoY to $134.6M) and reliance on multiple debt instruments. Recent issuances of $400M (2035 Notes) and $450M (2034 Notes) increase exposure. The Capital category is heavily weighted toward real estate, especially for acquisition-driven REITs.

risks.title: Interest Rate Sensitivity
risks.score_rationale: Multiple references to SOFR adjustments, interest rate swaps, and refinancing. The company used hedges (gains of $13.6M from closing swaps in May 2025), but the risk is recurring and intensified by issuing new fixed-rate debt at 5.6% amid macroeconomic uncertainty.

risks.title: Revenue Concentration Among a Few Major Tenants
risks.score_rationale: 66.8% of annualized rent comes from investment grade rated tenants, indicating high dependence. While this reduces default risk, the loss of a single major tenant could impact up to 5-10% of annual revenues.

risks.title: Risk of Unavailability of Future Financing
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly states there is 'no assurance' that financing will be available on favorable terms. This appears in the Liquidity section, a critical point for an externally growing REIT. Credit conditions could tighten rapidly.

risks.title: Rising Impairment Provisions
risks.score_rationale: Impairment provisions increased by 65% (from $7.2M to $11.9M), signaling potential deterioration in certain assets. The 10-K language is measured, but the signal is concerning and warrants monitoring.

risks.title: Dependence on an Acquisition-Driven Growth Model
risks.score_rationale: Revenue growth heavily relies on acquisitions (305 properties, $1.45B in 2025, a 12.8% YoY increase). The text acknowledges full impact is delayed, creating a risk of misalignment between expenses and revenues.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange or Liquidity Risk on Derivative Instruments
risks.score_rationale: Termination of forward-starting swaps ($325M) to hedge the 2035 Notes, resulting in a $13.6M gain in May 2025. This reflects active management but also complex exposure to interest rate and liquidity markets.

risks.title: Integration and Operational Risk from Rapid Acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: 305 acquisitions in one year (41 states, 29 sectors) require complex operational integration. General and administrative expenses increased by 18% ($6.9M), suggesting growth-related pressures.

ai_positioning.summary: ADC does not mention artificial intelligence in its 2025 10-K/20-F filing. No discussion of AI initiatives, AI-powered automation, or AI-related risks was detected.
